faq.label: How to Invest
faq.headline: What an investor needs to know.
faq.subtext: Answers to the most common questions about structure, access and the investment process.

items.q: What is the minimum investment ticket?
items.a: The typical minimum commitment is USD 250,000, with flexibility depending on the vehicle and transaction. Institutional co-investors operate with larger tickets.
We work exclusively with qualified investors: family offices, institutional investors and high-net-worth individuals who meet the accreditation requirements of their jurisdiction.
Each opportunity is structured in a dedicated vehicle (SPV) or fund, with governance, guarantees and terms defined according to the asset and jurisdiction.

items.q: What is the horizon and liquidity?
items.a: Investments are patient capital, with horizons of 4 to 7 years. Liquidity is tied to the asset's cycle; these are not short-term liquid instruments.
Investors receive quarterly institutional reporting, position statements and access to the data room with each vehicle's documentation.
With a confidential conversation. After signing a confidentiality agreement, we share the deck and the private placement memorandum (PPM) for the relevant mandate.
